# Fused multiply-add (IEEE 754-2008 clause 5.4.1). The product is exact;
# the preferred exponent is min(Q(x) + Q(y), Q(z)).

# --- FMA64 ---

# A gap past the scaling limit in either direction: the far operand reaches
# the result only as a sticky bit, and it still moves a directed rounding.

FMA64 even inexact 1 1 1E-100 -> 1.000000000000000
FMA64 up inexact 1 1 1E-100 -> 1.000000000000001
FMA64 down inexact 1 1 1E-100 -> 1.000000000000000
FMA64 up inexact 1 1 -1E-100 -> 1.000000000000000
FMA64 down inexact 1 1 -1E-100 -> 0.9999999999999999
FMA64 zero inexact 1 1 -1E-100 -> 0.9999999999999999
FMA64 up inexact 1E-100 1E-100 1 -> 1.000000000000001
FMA64 down inexact 1E-100 -1E-100 1 -> 0.9999999999999999
FMA128 even inexact 1 1 1E-1000 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000000
FMA128 up inexact 1 1 1E-1000 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000001
FMA128 down inexact 1 1 1E-1000 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000000
FMA128 up inexact 1 1 -1E-1000 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000000
FMA128 down inexact 1 1 -1E-1000 -> 0.9999999999999999999999999999999999
FMA128 zero inexact 1 1 -1E-1000 -> 0.9999999999999999999999999999999999
FMA128 up inexact 1E-1000 1E-1000 1 -> 1.000000000000000000000000000000001
FMA128 down inexact 1E-1000 -1E-1000 1 -> 0.9999999999999999999999999999999999
